title: Contracts and agency — Linden Supply
instructions: Linden Supply, a general partnership that distributes restaurant equipment, faces several legal questions. Select the best answer for each.

exhibits.title: Situations
exhibits.content:
1. Linden's former sales agent, fired on May 1, ordered $15,000 of goods on May 10 from a vendor he had dealt with for years. Linden never notified the vendor.
2. A Linden salesperson orally agreed to sell a used oven to a restaurant for $1,800. The restaurant later refused to pay; nothing was signed.
3. Linden mailed an acceptance of a supplier's offer on June 3; the supplier's revocation, mailed June 2, arrived June 5.
4. Linden, a merchant, sent a signed written offer to sell mixers at $400 each, "firm for 60 days." On day 20 it tried to revoke.
5. A Linden delivery driver, on his route, negligently injured a pedestrian.
6. A creditor of the partnership sues partner Rosa personally for an unpaid partnership debt.
7. Linden shipped goods FOB shipping point by common carrier; they were destroyed in transit.

rows.label: 1. Former agent's order
options: Linden is bound through apparent authority
Linden isn't bound because actual authority ended
Only the former agent is bound, because he was fired
rows.answer: Linden is bound through apparent authority
rows.explanation: Third parties who dealt with the agent are entitled to actual notice of termination.

rows.label: 2. Oral oven sale
options: Enforceable — it's under $5,000
Unenforceable under the statute of frauds (goods of $500 or more) unless an exception applies
Enforceable because Linden is a merchant
rows.answer: Unenforceable under the statute of frauds (goods of $500 or more) unless an exception applies
rows.explanation: UCC 2-201 requires a signed writing for goods of $500 or more.

rows.label: 3. Acceptance vs. revocation
options: A contract formed on June 3
No contract — the revocation was mailed first
No contract — acceptance is effective on receipt
rows.explanation: Acceptance is effective on dispatch; revocation only on receipt (June 5).

rows.label: 4. Merchant's firm offer
options: The revocation is ineffective — the offer is irrevocable for the stated 60 days
The revocation is effective because there's no consideration
The offer was never valid
rows.answer: The revocation is ineffective — the offer is irrevocable for the stated 60 days

rows.label: 5. Driver's accident
options: Only the driver is liable
Linden and the driver are both liable
Only Linden is liable
rows.answer: Linden and the driver are both liable
rows.explanation: Respondeat superior — within the scope of employment.

rows.label: 6. Rosa's personal liability
options: Rosa isn't personally liable
Rosa is personally liable (joint and several liability of general partners)
Rosa is liable only for her ownership share
rows.answer: Rosa is personally liable (joint and several liability of general partners)
rows.explanation: General partners have unlimited personal liability (creditors generally must first exhaust partnership assets).

rows.label: 7. Goods destroyed in transit
options: Linden bears the loss
The buyer bears the loss
The loss is split
rows.explanation: FOB shipping point: risk passed on delivery to the carrier.
